title: Cancellation and Missed Appointment Charges for Auto Glass Services Jobs
content:
Under **Auto Glass Services**, a customer may cancel any scheduled job. This customer term sets when a cancellation or a missed appointment results in a late-cancellation charge, and who pays it.

## The term

> A customer may cancel any scheduled job. A cancellation inside the tier's cancellation cutoff hours before the appointment start, or a missed appointment, posts a late-cancellation charge of the tier's late-cancellation fee when the job's glass had already been ordered; with no glass ordered, or on a tier whose fee is zero, nothing is charged. Insurance glass claim jobs carry the same fee, payable by the customer, never billed to the insurer. A weather-cancelled mobile job is never charged.

## Terms used

- **Cancellation** — the customer cancels the job while it is scheduled; the job closes as cancelled on the cancellation date.
- **Missed appointment** — the technician could not reach or access the vehicle in the appointment window; the job closes as missed.
- **Late** — a cancellation made inside the tier's cancellation cutoff hours before the appointment start. Where the tier's cutoff is 0, a cancellation is never late.
- **Late-cancellation charge** — a charge to the customer on the job, in the amount of the tier's late-cancellation fee.

## When the charge posts

| Event | Glass already ordered for the job | Tier's fee | Late-cancellation charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cancellation inside the cutoff | Yes | above zero | the tier's fee, charged to the customer |
| Cancellation inside the cutoff | No | any | nothing charged |
| Cancellation inside the cutoff | Yes | zero | nothing charged |
| Missed appointment | Yes | above zero | the tier's fee, charged to the customer |
| Missed appointment | No | any | nothing charged |
| Missed appointment | Yes | zero | nothing charged |
| Mobile job cancelled for weather | any | any | never charged |

## Insurance glass claim jobs

The fee on an insurance glass claim job is the same fee as on any other job of the tier. It is payable by the customer and is never billed to the insurer.

## Hypothetical illustrations

1. A customer cancels a job 10 hours before the appointment start, on a tier whose cutoff is, for illustration, 24 hours and whose fee is 40.00; the glass for the job had already been ordered. The cancellation is inside the cutoff, so a late-cancellation charge of 40.00 posts to the customer.
2. The same job, cancelled at the same moment, but no glass had yet been ordered: nothing is charged.
3. An insurance glass claim job on that tier is missed after its glass was ordered: the 40.00 charge is the customer's to pay and is not billed to the insurer.
